ns = 32766  # NUMBER_OF_FIELDS
np = 16384  # NUMBER_OF_SETS
with open('/tmp/overflow.cgats', 'w') as f:
    f.write('CTE1\n')
    f.write('NUMBER_OF_SETS %d\n' % np)
    f.write('NUMBER_OF_FIELDS %d\n' % ns)
    f.write('BEGIN_DATA_FORMAT\n')
    for i in range(ns):
        f.write('F%d\n' % i)
    f.write('END_DATA_FORMAT\n')
    f.write('BEGIN_DATA\n')
    # write np+1 items to trigger overflow at index np (16384)
    for i in range(np+1):
        f.write('0.1\n')
    f.write('END_DATA\n')
print('done')
"
ls -la /tmp/overflow.cgats
